title: Minkä with a plural genitive noun
summary: Use unchanged minkä with a plural genitive noun: Minkä maiden lippu tämä on? (“Which countries' flag is this?”).
targetSkills: Minkä with a plural genitive noun
prerequisiteSkills: Minkä with a singular genitive noun

objectives: Use unchanged minkä with a plural genitive noun: Minkä maiden lippu tämä on? (“Which countries' flag is this?”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: Mikä (“which/what”) becomes minkä before a genitive noun. Minkä has the same form in singular and plural; the following noun expresses the number.
Use these noun models: maa → maiden/maitten, koulu → koulujen, talo → talojen, auto → autojen.
The question identifies a relationship: which country a flag belongs to, which school or house a part belongs to, or which car a key belongs to. The singular head noun keeps on.
keyPoints: Keep minkä unchanged for the requested number.
